decisions.reason: Define-XML ADAE.TRTEMFL explicitly assigns 'N' otherwise, and the literal probe implements that branch with the documented nonmissing date comparison. The 65 reference blanks are missing character flags, not the documented 'N'.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM literally contains 'SUBC UTANEOUS'; the probe preserves that equality and the exact exclusions, with character missing serialized as blank. The 181 differences follow from that spelling, and the corrected-spelling reading is supported by the dermatologic query description in ADRG page-11.

Within Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL, CQ01NAM='' selects records outside the populated dermatologic query, while the same method's parenthetical says to flag the first treatment-emergent dermatological event. Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM assigns 'DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS' to query members and missing otherwise, so these clauses describe different subsets.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL selects empty CQ01NAM, whereas ADRG pages 11-12 explicitly flag the first chronological treatment-emergent dermatological event. Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM identifies dermatological query members by the populated 'DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS' value, making the subsets contradictory.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL literally selects CQ01NAM='', which the probe tests with empty strings preserved, subject grouping and the stated start-date/sequence ordering. The 327 differences follow from that subset, while the populated-query reading agrees with the reference and the dermatological-event purpose in ADRG pages 11-12.

Define-XML ADAE.TRTEMFL requires 'N' otherwise; the executable TRTEMFL case at adae.yaml lines 830-847 only assigns 'Y'. The copied submission-method description contains the 'N' text, but no derivation branch in the specification implements it.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM uses exact equality to 'SKIN AND SUBC UTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS'. CQ01_SOC at adae.yaml lines 857-865 uses an unanchored extraction with 'SUBCUTANEOUS', changing both the literal spelling and match condition.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM excludes exact terms in the named list. CQ01_EXCL at adae.yaml lines 866-874 extracts those strings wherever they occur, and CQ01NAM excludes every extraction match, so containing terms can be excluded as well.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL explicitly selects CQ01NAM='', while SEQ_OCC01 at adae.yaml lines 995-1010 selects CQ01NAM='DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS'. Both require TRTEMFL='Y', but the query-name predicates select different records.

Native Define-XML IT.ADAE.STUDYID at lines 2016-2025 has a Predecessor Origin whose child description is 'ADSL.STUDYID'; workbook Variables row 42 repeats this source. The projected section omits that origin, so the derivation is documented despite the specification reading AE.STUDYID.

Native Define-XML IT.ADAE.USUBJID at lines 2034-2042 has a Predecessor Origin whose child description is 'ADSL.USUBJID'; workbook Variables row 44 repeats this source. The projected section omits that origin, so the derivation is documented despite the specification reading AE.USUBJID.

Define-XML ADAE.AENDT and workbook Methods row 24 state only conversion of AE.AEENDTC to a numeric SAS date. ADRG page-8 limits its day-imputation instruction to ASTDT, and no retained section or native end-date metadata states the last-day completion used by AENDT.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCCFL and workbook Methods row 49 state grouping within Subject (USUBJID), without a separate STUDYID partition. ADRG page-11 describes the AE-to-ADAE linking keys and SDTM AE.USUBJID describes identifier construction; neither states the additional occurrence partition in SEQ_OCC.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCCFL and workbook Methods row 49 name the sort variables but do not prescribe missing-value placement. No retained section or native metadata states the nulls-last policy made explicit in SEQ_OCC.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCCSFL and workbook Methods row 51 group within Subject and SOC, without a separate STUDYID partition. ADRG page-11 describes record-linking keys rather than occurrence grouping, and no retained source states the additional partition in SEQ_OCCS.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCCSFL and workbook Methods row 51 name subject, SOC, start date and sequence in the sort but leave missing-value placement unstated. No retained section or native metadata supplies the nulls-last policy in SEQ_OCCS.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCCPFL and workbook Methods row 50 group within Subject, SOC and PT, without a separate STUDYID partition. ADRG page-11 states record-linking keys rather than occurrence grouping, and no retained source states the additional partition in SEQ_OCCP.
